nws.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory until 1 PM EDT: king tide flooding possible along Biscayne Bay
Flash Flood Watch until 8 PM EDT: heavy rain on saturated ground in southwest Miami-Dade

news.title: Crash blocks two lanes on I-95 NB at NE 125th St
news.summary: Two right lanes are blocked and traffic is backed up past NW 95th St while crews clear the scene.

news.title: Crash blocks two lanes on SR-826 NB at Bird Rd
news.summary: The Palmetto is slow northbound after a two-lane crash at the Bird Rd interchange.

news.title: NE 151st St closed at Biscayne Blvd because of flooding
news.summary: High tide flooding has closed both directions at the Biscayne Blvd intersection near the FIU BBC campus.

news.title: Multi-car crash delays Okeechobee Rd near W 12th Ave
news.summary: One lane is open while Hialeah police work a multi-car crash on Okeechobee Rd.

news.title: Heavy rain floods US-1 south of Homestead
news.summary: Southbound lanes near SW 344th St are covered with water after an overnight storm.

news.title: Police activity closes one lane on Brickell Ave
news.summary: One southbound lane is closed at SE 8th St while police respond; expect delays through the morning.
